items.sku: Wine and Cheese Event with Leelanau Cellars and Leelanau Cheese

items.productTitle: Leelanau Cheese celebrates its 30th anniversary by returning to the place where it all began: 5019 North West Bay Shore Drive in Omena, Michigan, the current home to Leelanau Cellars’ Tasting Room. Enjoy a Wine and Cheese Pairing with expert analysis from both Leelanau Cheese and Leelanau Cellars, two of the most established and well-known companies in the area. The evening will feature four different wine and cheese pairings, along with a guide through the extensive process of cheese-making from Leelanau Cheese’s Director of Operations. Leelanau Cellars’ winemakers selected award-winning wine to complement each delightful cheese. The event will be on March 1 at 5 p.m. at Leelanau Cellars’ tasting room. Tickets are limited. We look forward to seeing you at the celebration of these two Leelanau County staples.
